name: sale.order.list.inherit.sale.stock
arch:
<data><field name="commitment_date" position="attributes">
                <attribute name="decoration-danger">
                    (
                        (
                            commitment_date < effective_date
                            or commitment_date < datetime.datetime.combine(
                                datetime.date.today(),
                                datetime.time(0,0,0)
                            ).to_utc().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
                        )
                        and delivery_status in ['pending', 'started']
                        and effective_date <= commitment_date
                        or delivery_status == 'partial'
                    )
                </attribute>
            </field>
            <field name="invoice_status" position="before">
                <field name="delivery_status" decoration-success="delivery_status == 'full'" decoration-warning="delivery_status == 'partial'" decoration-info="delivery_status in ['pending', 'started']" widget="badge" optional="hide"/>
            </field>
